applicabilityBasis.summary: SAFO is the USD accumulation share class (ISIN FR0014015LE1) of the Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund sub-fund of SPIKO SICAV, a French UCITS. Each token registers an investment-fund share with proportional asset and voting rights; accumulated income increases share value. These fund securities are excluded from the GENIUS payment-stablecoin definition by section 2(22)(B)(iii), not ordinary dollar payment liabilities.

genius.notes: The prospectus identifies SPIKO SICAV as the French UCITS and SAFO as its sub-fund. Spiko Finance is the distributor/transfer agent and Amundi is delegated investment manager; neither role converts the fund share into a payment stablecoin. UCITS/AMF fund regulation is not GENIUS PPSI authorization. Business-day redemption at fund share value is not an issuer promise to redeem a fixed dollar amount. GENIUS reserve and monthly-attestation indicators are intentionally omitted: investment-portfolio disclosure is not a payment-stablecoin reserve assessment.
